verdicts.reason: A: 'Solstice Presents' sits below its own headline, and the date, tagline, URL and '6 pm' lines are jammed together with mixed left/centred alignment. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill lost among the badges at the bottom, and a large dead band sits between the phone and the footer. B has the same hierarchy failures (CTA turned into a small pill, eyebrow moved below the headline), and its text block is more ragged: the date, URL and '6 pm' lines each start at a different indent, and the copy is smaller. The broken placeholder image has been blown up into a prominent box in the middle of the layout, and the phone floats over the decorative circle, so B is slightly worse.
